questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery. Slow down when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs tell drivers that an action is prohibited. This sign means you are traveling the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is unsafe and illegal to make a left turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards ahead. They are yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign shows you are near a school. Watch for children and stop if they are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to immediate hazards. This sign tells you traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign directs you to stay to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. They warn you about upcoming road conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for animals, people, and vehicles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns you about an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you to move in the direction shown by the arrow—in this case, to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look and listen carefully, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns you about traffic signals at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. When posted at an intersection, this sign means you cannot turn right or left on a red signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must obey. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on a vehicle means it travels at slow speeds. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks solid orange during the day and hollow red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You will often see it at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers of upcoming hazards or conditions. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel at slow speeds.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns you that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a dangerous downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be steep, long, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming situations. This sign warns you that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane will split into two directions. You can choose to turn left or continue straight ahead.
